summary: Round 10, narrow re-check against the round-9 bytes (f22764f3). Still prose only -- no production logic, no wire change, and nothing in this diff adds, moves or authorises an object-store request. The three edits are all inside M5.66's cell at backlog.md:126 and I checked each against what I passed at rounds 7-9. (1) The K = 64 case closes the hole the test role opened: it names the coalesce survivor, its ~131,072-byte interleave gap and the 65-against-1 count, and it sits under the standing clause 'THE BOUNDED PATH IS AT MOST TWO REQUESTS AT EVERY K', so a K = 64 case asserting the bounded path's request count reds coalesce(ranges, 64 KiB). Nothing I passed at rounds 7-9 breaks: the two-sided pair, the bytes-bounded-above clause, the symmetric RTT predicate, 3b and the codec-refuse arm are all byte-identical and still red their named mutations. (2) The sharing/shape distinction is SOUND in substance and I tried to break it. M5.45h's title is 'ONE FETCH PER (NODE, SEGMENT)', its criterion 1 contrasts 'one fetch PER RUN' against per-node, and its 'counts INVOCATIONS, not distinct URLs' clause exists to stop a Set<String> collapsing K identical per-run GETs to 1 (Grant has value equality over (url, expiresAt)) -- every word of it targets the SHARING axis. A two-request shape is O(1) in K, so restating the count as two per (node, segment) still reds the per-run implementation at K = 64 (it reports 64 or 128, not 2). That is a correction of a conflation, not a loosening, and the row is right to refuse the loosening. (3) The 'this row's format half has no dependency' qualification at both sites is literally true and the conclusions it introduces (count every request the path makes, take the assertion on the TOTAL) are independently carried, so I am not reopening the round-9 minor. WHAT BLOCKS IS THE OTHER HALF OF THE SAME RESOLUTION: the distinction is sound but it is assigned to a row that by its own State cell cannot act in the window the sentence names. M5.66 depends on M5.45h; next-task calls a row depending on an unfinished task blocked; so M5.66's owner arrives after M5.45h is done, when 'it is todo, so this is a criteria edit and not a test change' is false and the only escape the cell offers is closed. Detail below. The repair is one sentence in M5.45h's own cell, which is todo today and in the file this diff already edits.

findings.location: docs/internal/product/backlog.md:126 (M5.66 criterion 2, 'this row owes M5.45h's criterion the distinction before M5.45h is taken (it is `todo`, so this is a criteria edit and not a test change)'), against the same cell's State column 'todo -- depends on M5.45g and M5.45h' and M5.45h's own cell at backlog.md:69
findings.title: The sharing/shape distinction is sound, but it is owed by M5.66 'before M5.45h is taken' while M5.66 is declared BLOCKED ON M5.45h -- the obligation cannot be discharged in the window it names, and nothing in M5.45h's cell points back here, so the collision this round convened to resolve survives unresolved
findings.failure_scenario:
THE ORDER IS FIXED AND IT IS THE WRONG WAY ROUND. M5.66's State cell reads 'todo -- **depends on M5.45g and M5.45h**'; M5.45h's reads 'todo -- depends on M5.45g AND on M5.62'. next-task/SKILL.md:15 defines a task as blocked if it depends on an unfinished task and SKILL.md:13 says take the top UNBLOCKED task, so M5.66 is not takeable until M5.45h is done. 'This row' is M5.66 throughout this cell ('this row trades a request for bandwidth', 'this row's `format` half has no dependency'), so the sentence assigns the criteria edit to the one owner who is guaranteed to arrive too late.

WALK IT. M5.45g lands, M5.62 lands, M5.45h is taken. Its owner reads M5.45h's cell only -- that cell contains no reference to M5.66, to the sharing/shape distinction, or to a two-request shape; it says 'a node holding K runs of one segment issues ONE fetch ... asserted at K = 64' with 'THE FAKE COUNTS INVOCATIONS, NOT DISTINCT URLS'. Nothing routes that owner here, so they write exactly that test, and at M5.45h time it is CORRECT: no bounded path exists yet, so production really does issue one whole-object GET. M5.66 then unblocks. Its owner switches the bounded path on at K = 64 -- every crossover this cell records (169, 213, 1,556) is above 64 and criterion 1 forbids a threshold merely compared to the recorded number -- and M5.45h's criterion-1 case now counts TWO invocations of the widened seam, the total criterion 2 itself insists on. At that moment the cell's parenthetical is false: M5.45h is `done`, its test exists, and 'a criteria edit and not a test change' is unavailable. The owner is left with precisely the two exits this same sentence forbids -- edit a landed assertion from one to two (a weakening in another row's test, non-negotiable 2 and testing.md rule 5, invisible to check-test-integrity because it is a different row's test), or keep whole-object at K = 64 and discharge criterion 1's derivedFrom requirement at a single K, which makes the coalesce implementation the specified one rather than a mutation of it. That is the identical pair of exits the test role named at round 9; naming the axis does not remove either one, because the axis is recorded where the person who could act on it will never read it.

AND IT IS THIS ROW'S OWN NAMED DEFECT. The cell says 'a correction applied to one of two places is this milestone's most repeated defect' and 'the half-landed fix this task has now produced six times'. This is that shape once more: the distinction is written in the cell that DISCOVERED the collision and not in the cell whose wording conflates the axes and whose test will encode the conflation.

WHAT CLOSES IT, cheaply and in this commit: M5.45h is `todo` TODAY and backlog.md is already staged, so make the criteria edit now -- one clause in M5.45h's criterion 1 saying its ONE fetch is the SHARING unit, one operation per (node, segment) rather than one per client, whose SHAPE may be one request or the header-plus-slice pair M5.66 may introduce, with the invocation count asserted as a constant independent of K rather than as the literal 1. That keeps every mutation M5.45h's criterion currently kills (per-run gives 64 or 128 at K = 64; the empty-array coalescing still fails the all-K-runs-decode half). If touching M5.45h's cell is judged outside M5.45f's scope, the minimum is a pointer IN M5.45h's cell to M5.66's distinction, so the obligation reaches the owner who can discharge it -- because 'M5.66 owes it before M5.45h is taken' is, given M5.66's declared dependency, a sentence no one can act on.
